Copilot instructions — raisinbl/arch

Purpose

Complete Arch Linux installation and configuration automation. This repo provides scripts, package lists, and system configurations for fresh Arch installs on new hardware (Lenovo IdeaPad 5 Pro 14ACN6).

1) Build / test / lint commands

- This is not a software project; there are no build/test/lint suites.
- Primary commands:

  **Installation:**
  ```bash
  # Full automated install (validates, installs, logs results)
  ./first_time.sh
  
  # Validate packages before install (check what might fail)
  ./pkg/validate_packages.sh
  
  # Regenerate package lists from current system
  ./pkg/get_pkg.sh
  ```

  **Archinstall (base system automated setup):**
  ```bash
  # Local config
  archinstall --config archinstall/user_configuration.json \
              --creds archinstall/user_credentials.json \
              --disk_layouts archinstall/user_disk_layout.json
  
  # Remote config (from GitHub)
  archinstall --config https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raisinbl/arch/master/archinstall/user_configuration.json \
              --creds https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raisinbl/arch/master/archinstall/user_credentials.json \
              --disk_layouts https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raisinbl/arch/master/archinstall/user_disk_layout.json
  ```

2) High-level architecture (big picture)

- **Purpose**: Reproducible Arch Linux setup for Lenovo IdeaPad 5 Pro 14ACN6 (reference: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Lenovo_IdeaPad_5_Pro_14ACN6)
- **Workflow**: 
  1. Automated disk partitioning and base system install (archinstall)
  2. Package installation with error handling (first_time.sh)
  3. System configuration (ACPI handlers, environment variables, utilities)
  4. Deploy dotfiles from companion repo (.dotfiles) using stow

- **Key directories**:
  - `archinstall/` - Pre-configured JSON configs for automated system install
  - `pkg/` - Official and AUR package lists, validation/installation scripts
  - `settings/` - System configurations (ACPI event handlers for brightness/audio/etc)
  - `sys/` - System environment setup (fcitx IME configuration)
  - `utils/` - Utility scripts (night-mode.sh for screen filtering)

3) Key conventions and repository-specific patterns

- **Package lists are source of truth**: `pkg/pkglist.txt` (official) and `pkg/pkglist_aur.txt` (AUR)
  - Comments allowed: `# comment text`
  - Empty lines ignored
  - Regenerate with `./pkg/get_pkg.sh` after setup on current system to keep fresh

- **Error handling**: See INSTALLATION_STRATEGY.md for detailed approach
  - `./first_time.sh` installs packages individually (one failure ≠ total failure)
  - Failed packages logged to `/tmp/failed_official_packages.txt` and `/tmp/failed_aur_packages.txt`
  - Always validate first: `./pkg/validate_packages.sh`

- **System settings are configuration, not code**:
  - ACPI event handlers in `settings/acpi/events/` trigger on hardware events
  - ACPI handlers (.sh files) execute custom actions (e.g., brightness-handler.sh)
  - `/etc/environment` is generated by `sys/env.sh` (not yet integrated; manual step)

- **Archinstall configs are declarative**:
  - `.json` files define entire system state (partitions, users, packages, bootloader)
  - Can be run locally or from remote GitHub URL
  - Minimal manual intervention needed post-archinstall

4) File reference guide

| File | Purpose | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| `first_time.sh` | Main installation orchestrator | Runs after archinstall; handles packages with graceful failure |
| `pkg/pkglist.txt` | Official Arch packages | One per line; regenerate after system setup |
| `pkg/pkglist_aur.txt` | AUR packages | One per line; regenerate after system setup |
| `pkg/get_pkg.sh` | Regenerate package lists | Captures currently installed packages from system |
| `pkg/validate_packages.sh` | Pre-install validation | Identifies packages that don't exist before wasting time |
| `archinstall/user_configuration.json` | Base system config | Partitioning, bootloader, users, timezone, etc. |
| `archinstall/user_credentials.json` | User/auth config | Username, password, sudo config |
| `archinstall/user_disk_layout.json` | Disk partitioning | EFI, root, home partition layout |
| `settings/acpi/` | Hardware event handlers | Brightness, audio, mic toggle on hardware events |
| `sys/env.sh` | Environment variables | Sets fcitx IME and electron platform hints |
| `utils/night-mode.sh` | Screen blue-light filter | Optional utility |
| `INSTALLATION_STRATEGY.md` | Error handling docs | Read before troubleshooting install failures |

5) Installation workflow for new device

```bash
# Step 1: Clone this repo
git clone https://github.com/raisinbl/arch.git ~/arch
cd ~/arch

# Step 2: (Optional) Validate packages to see what might fail
./pkg/validate_packages.sh

# Step 3: Run full installation
./first_time.sh
# This will:
# - Update pacman database
# - Install all official packages (skips failed ones)
# - Install paru if not present
# - Install all AUR packages (skips failed ones)
# - Log everything to /tmp/arch_install_<timestamp>.log

# Step 4: Check results
cat /tmp/arch_install_*.log  # full log
cat /tmp/failed_official_packages.txt  # official package failures
cat /tmp/failed_aur_packages.txt  # AUR failures

# Step 5: (If failures) Fix and re-run
# Option A: Update lists
./pkg/get_pkg.sh
git add pkg/pkglist*.txt
git commit -m "update: refresh package lists"
./first_time.sh

# Option B: Remove problematic packages manually
vim pkg/pkglist_aur.txt
./first_time.sh

# Step 6: Deploy dotfiles (from .dotfiles repo)
git clone https://github.com/raisinbl/.dotfiles.git ~/.dotfiles
cd ~/.dotfiles
git submodule update --init --recursive
stow home_config
```

6) Key implementation details

- **paru installation**: Builds from AUR; uses makepkg with `--needed` to skip if already installed
- **Graceful package failure**: Each package attempted independently; logs to `/tmp/failed_*.txt`
- **Archinstall**: Declarative system config; run manually before `first_time.sh` on clean install
- **System environment**: `sys/env.sh` writes to `/etc/environment` (requires sudo); not yet auto-integrated

7) Troubleshooting

- **Package fails to install**: Check `/tmp/arch_install_*.log` for details; likely outdated/removed from AUR
- **paru fails to build**: Ensure base-devel is installed; may need manual intervention
- **Archinstall fails**: Review JSON syntax or use interactive mode instead
- **ACPI handlers not working**: Ensure acpid service is running; handlers must be executable

Notes

- Target device: Lenovo IdeaPad 5 Pro 14ACN6 (may work on similar hardware)
- Companion repo: https://github.com/raisinbl/.dotfiles (deploy configs after package install)
- Strategy docs: Read INSTALLATION_STRATEGY.md for detailed error handling approach
- Keep package lists fresh: Run `./pkg/get_pkg.sh` after system setup and commit updates
